title: Night Credit for an Equipment-Fault Swap — PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Night Credit for an Equipment-Fault Swap — PAP Therapy Equipment

**Credit note.** Nights lost to an equipment fault are credited on a PAP Therapy Equipment usage summary, in addition to the qualifying nights counted from the downloaded windows:

- a record whose **latest malfunction swap** was made by an **in-home visit** is credited **2 nights**;
- a record with a swap made **any other way** is credited **1 night**;
- a record without a swap is credited none.

**Where it is read.** A malfunction swap is a delivery in the device's service history whose purpose is a malfunction swap; how it was made is that delivery's mode — in-home setup, branch setup, virtual setup or courier. Where several swaps are recorded, the latest one decides.

| Malfunction swap on the record | Mode of the latest swap | Nights credited |
|---|---|---|
| yes | in-home setup | 2 |
| yes | branch setup, virtual setup or courier | 1 |
| no | — | 0 |

**Cases (hypothetical).** Two swaps, the first in the home and the latest by courier: 1 night. One swap, made in the home: 2 nights.
